verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing explicitly claims rule-based automation ('rules that move work forward', AI-assisted automations, customizable workflows), matching the trigger-and-action automation story, but the evidence pack has no independent/hands-on confirmation of how this automation builder actually performs, and community commentary never discusses the automation feature specifically. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the automation rule builder in use, details on trigger/condition/action configuration, and confirmation it eliminates manual steps in practice.
